classification: Curated numeric summary of private bench hardware evidence; not raw telemetry or an independently repeatable public hardware trace
fault: Operator unplugged only the isolated Ethernet bench cable, then restored it; router stayed powered
manual_reconciliation: Exact owned path removed after reporter hash check; absence verified over a separate read-only SSH connection; append-only history retained

provenance.device_execution: Human operator in interactive Terminal; password entered directly to SSH
provenance.local_verification: Codex read private saved evidence and independently recomputed aggregate CPU counter ratios
provenance.exit_statuses: Operator terminal transcript; successful post-stop sample also persisted
provenance.directory_absence: Operator-executed read-only SSH check; saved local output inspected by Codex

scope_limits: One supervised cable-loss and recovery sequence
Private bench defaults; portable copy not separately hardware-tested
No proof of every interruption or cleanup failure mode
No AP, USB/NAS, firmware-change or reboot acceptance
CPU utilisation is a snapshot ratio, not incremental monitoring-overhead measurement
SSH master conclusion is from its local control socket, not an independent process identity check
